steps.title: Wallet Overview
steps.action: User checks coin balance and taps 'Withdraw Cash'
steps.response: Checks minimum threshold; opens Payout Form

steps.title: Payout Method Form
steps.action: User enters UPI ID (e.g. mobile@upi) and confirms payout amount

steps.title: Withdrawal Processing Screen
steps.action: System initiates IMPS/UPI transfer with 24-hr status SLA
steps.response: Logs debit entry in Transaction History

steps.title: Transaction Ledger
steps.action: User reviews historical deposits and payout records
